title: Seller and Account Executive Productivity Agent

approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Sellers begin the day across a scatter of tabs and spreadsheets, assembling an account picture by hand before the first call. Product detail, campaign availability and account signals each live somewhere different.
script.vo02: Ranked model scores arrive as numbers, and someone still has to turn them into something worth saying.
script.vo03: It reads Account records, Product and battlecard content. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams. And it can assemble the account picture ahead of the meeting, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A seller asks the agent to prepare for tomorrow's meeting. It reads the account record, the product detail and the recent signals, then returns a single briefing instead of a morning of tab-switching.
script.vo05: Asked for the plan, the agent lays out the conversation in order - the opening, the questions worth asking, and the campaign this account is eligible for.
script.vo06: Then the risk question. The agent names the claims it cannot support, flags where the account data has gone stale, and marks what needs checking before anyone walks in.
script.vo_payoff: Sellers arrive prepared, with the account picture already assembled and the signals already put into plain words.
script.vo_helps: The result? One place to prepare, shorter preparation before every conversation, and model output expressed in words a seller can use.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
